title: For every morphism f:X→Y of schemes with ell invertible, the actual constructible completed integral pullback followed by coherent system reduction is naturally isomorphic to coherent system reduction followed by exact finite-system inverse image
statement: For every morphism f:X→Y of schemes with ell invertible, the actual constructible completed integral pullback followed by coherent system reduction is naturally isomorphic to coherent system reduction followed by exact finite-system inverse image. At every positive uniformizer exponent and every good representative its evaluation is the actual scalar adjoint of the Roos projection, transported through the specified finite pullback and reduction counit comparisons.

source.place: Tags 099N(2),(5); 0941 in sites-cohomology.tex; Bhatt--Scholze Lemma 3.5.7; extracted from lem-pod-integral-pullback-composition steps 1--3.

proof.text: Use the canonical source and target coefficient evaluation calculi chosen in integralSystemReduction. Obtain a Roos model on each scheme from normalizedCompletedOperationModels on its singleton family. Apply effectiveQuotientModelDescent with the identity coefficient inclusion to those very calculi and Roos models: its pullback model supplies the normalized natural realization, and its ambient effectivity clause makes the target whole-system counit invertible on each pulled-back reduction.

Whisker the normalized realization by target reduction and compose with the whole-system adjunction counit. On every constructible input the first factor is the image of an isomorphism and the second factor is invertible by effectivity. Restrict this natural transformation along the full constructible inclusion and use NatIso.ofComponents with the component inverses. The sequence-site and finite-system pullback presentations are definitionally identical.

Apply integralPullbackCounitProjection to the selected source and target calculi, Roos model, normalized pullback realization, arbitrary good representative, and arbitrary level n. Cancel the inverse target reduction-evaluation isomorphism. Unfold only integralSystemPullbackReductionIso and the isomorphism-composition formulas: its four factors are exactly the right-hand side of the projection identity. This proves the required equality for every representative and every positive exponent.

theorem integralPullbackSystemComparison :
    ∃ β : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
        [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
        [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] (f : X ⟶ Y),
        constructibleIntegralPullback l E f ⋙ integralSystemReduction l E X ≅
          integralSystemReduction l E Y ⋙
            finiteSystemDerivedPullback (integralSystemRings l E) (integralSystemTransition l E) f,
      ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
        [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
        [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] (f : X ⟶ Y)
        (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y)
        (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory)
        (e : (DerivedCategory.Q (C := scalarReductionSource l E Y)).obj P.obj ≅ K.obj) (n : ℕ),
        (finiteSystemDerivedEvaluation (integralSystemRings l E)
          (integralSystemTransition l E) X n).map ((β f).hom.app K) ≫
            (finiteSystemDerivedPullbackEvaluation (integralSystemRings l E)
              (integralSystemTransition l E) f n).hom.app
                ((integralSystemReduction l E Y).obj K) ≫
            (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback
              (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) f).map
                ((integralSystemReductionEvaluation l E Y n).hom.app K) =
          (integralSystemReductionEvaluation l E X n).hom.app
              ((constructibleIntegralPullback l E f).obj K) ≫
            (integralSystemPullbackReductionIso l E f K P e n).hom
